          # specs/$slug in a comment is documentation, not a path
          spec_dir="$(bash "$lib" spec-dir "$project" "$slug")"
          test -f "$project/.specify/memory/constitution.md"
          ls -d "$base"/[0-9][0-9][0-9]-*
          ls -d "$p"/.claude/skills/speckit-*
          run_id="${RUN_URL##*/}"
